summary: Full backend + frontend test of the NewMusiq clone (Clerk auth). Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (/api/me 401/200 + invalid token 401, PUT /api/me validation + photo types + photo persistence, /api/me/photo bytes match and 404 for new user, comments empty/no-profile/auth checks, pending visible only to the author, geo search Paris + short query 422). Frontend at desktop 1920: /sign-in and /sign-up split layout with the Clerk card work, and the sign-up Back button works. Signing in by ticket with a completed profile lands on home (5 nav items, avatar photo, display name, globe, search, player bar), and the session survives a refresh. A new user is sent to /complete-profile (going to / also sends them back there), and the empty form shows an error. Filling the form with a photo saves it and goes home; the sidebar avatar shows the uploaded image (checked by pixel color) and is still there after reload. Clicking the track title expands the player with lyrics and comments; a posted comment shows 'Pending review'; collapse works. Globe search: 'Japan' shows 'Showing Japan', an unknown place shows 'No matching location was found.', and the zoom +/fit/- buttons click. Account menu: Edit profile opens a prefilled form titled 'Save Changes'; Sign out goes to /sign-in. Mobile 390px: bottom nav renders, but the account menu cannot be reached and the player bar is misaligned.

minor.issue: Redundant 'import math' inside the function (math is already imported at the top). Cosmetic.
Hard limit of 20 with no pagination; fine for an MVP.

ui_bugs.issue: .sidebar-profile is display:none on mobile, so there is no avatar/name and no way to reach the account menu (Edit profile / Sign out). Mobile users cannot sign out or edit their profile.

The Back button goes to /sign-in. SignedOutOnly sends the signed-in user to /, and Home sends them back to /complete-profile, so Back does nothing. The page has no sign-out option either, so a new user who wants to leave or switch accounts is stuck.

The player bar card is off-center: x=28, width 362, so it touches the right edge of the screen with 0 right margin. The progress thumb dot shows below the card above the bottom nav. The expanded player has the same offset.

integration_issues.issue: Any failure in refresh(), including a failed /me/photo fetch (storage hiccup) or a temporary /me error, runs setProfile({completed:false}). That wrongly sends users who already have a completed profile to /complete-profile as if they were new. The photo fetch error should be caught on its own, and a /me failure should show an error or retry state.

issues: The photo picker circle sits flush against the left edge of the form inputs with no gap, so it looks cramped and uneven.
The Clerk card (withSignUp combined flow) shows no 'Don't have an account? Sign up' link. Users can only find /sign-up by typing a new email.

action_items: Mobile: make the account menu (Edit profile / Sign out) reachable, e.g. add a profile/avatar item to the bottom nav or a header avatar button
/complete-profile for a new user: add a Sign out option and fix the Back button, which currently goes nowhere
profile.jsx: catch the /me/photo failure on its own, and don't treat a /me error as completed:false
Mobile player bar: fix the horizontal offset/width so it is centered with even margins, and hide the stray progress thumb under the card
Optional: add a visible sign-up link on /sign-in; add a gap between the photo picker and the inputs
critical_code_review_comments: lib/profile.jsx refresh(): a single try covers /me and /me/photo, so a photo error leads to a false redirect to complete-profile
server.py: the duplicate 'import math' inside geo_search is redundant
No create/edit-profile UI for a photo larger than 5MB beyond the client-side check; the backend also checks size. Fine.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sign in with <preview>/sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<ticket>; tickets are single-use, so make a new one each run. Use page.evaluate(el.click()) because the WebGL globe slows actionability checks. Timers and debounced UI statuses lag in headless mode, so wait 3-5s before reading globe-search-status or comment-status. Run the backend regression with: /root/.venv/bin/python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_newmusiq_api.py
